olivia-mkt: Quick riff  launch a "Lightning Ref Starters" program: weekly 1-page tutorials + a one-file OSS refapp + a tiny performance card. goal: <5min friction to a running demo. thoughts? :zap:
devrel-max: Love it. Keep CTA: "Run in 5". Each post: 2-min read, one curl snippet, Docker run, and bench snapshot.
indra-eng: Agree. Refapp constraints: single-source file (py/node), endpoints: /health /invoke /embed. ENV var REDWOOD_API_KEY. Single Dockerfile + minimal deps. I'll produce a starter template.
zoe-ux: Visuals: small benchmark card (p50/p95, cost/1k) + 5s GIF showing request->response. I can make a template so series looks cohesive.
noah-sales: Inbound routing: blog microform with fields: use-case, team size, demo interest. If "enterprise" checked -> webhook to CRM + AE queue. Small teams -> nurture drip and newsletter. Capture timezone for office hour invites.
olivia-mkt: Bench plan: compare hosted-small, dedicated-default, private-quantized. Metrics: p50, p95, cost/1k tokens, tokens/sec. Indra, can you own the scripts?
indra-eng: Yep. I'll script a 256-token runner, output CSV, and add a GH Action to publish the CSV artifact on release. Will add a secret-scan guard.
devrel-max: Distribution: blog post + 4-tweet thread + community newsletter + pinned GH issue. Week 3 -> 30m office hours. Encourage community PRs with label "lightning-ref" and a CONTRIBUTING.md.
ci-bot: CI checklist added: lint -> build -> bench -> publish artifact. Recommend secret-scan and 30-day artifact retention.
olivia-mkt: Timeline (pilot): week0 scaffold + baseline bench; week1 snack #1 publish; week2 snack #2; week3 snack #3 + office hours; week4 community picks.
noah-sales: For enterprise leads, propose a short gated demo flow: form -> AE follow-up. Keep main content ungated to maximize reach.
zoe-ux: I'll deliver hero variants for A/B and GIF template by Monday.
devrel-max: Content checklist: short explainer, code snippet, screenshot/GIF, bench card, repo link, contributor credit. I'll draft Snack #1 tonight ("Simple reranker in 5").
olivia-mkt: Great. Assign: indra (bench + templates), devrel-max (content + office hours), zoe-ux (visuals), noah-sales (inbound). We'll measure CTR, form conversions, and PRs. Pilot run = 5 weeks. :rocket:
